$V$ & $(n+1)m+2(m+1)$: $n+1$ rings of $m$ along the tube + two end discs (centre + own ring)\\
$T$ & $2nm+2m$: two per tube cell + an $m$-fan per end\\
drawn & \texttt{createHelix(0.42, 0.07, 2, 24, 6)}: $V=164$, $T=300$\\
scene & \texttt{createHelix(0.475, 0.025, 5, 120, 6)}: $V=740$, $T=1\,452$; 52 parts in the scene\\
\bottomrule\end{tabularx}}\end{minipage}\hfill\begin{minipage}[t]{0.37\linewidth}{\fontsize{7}{8}\selectfont\textbf{(e) Used for}: 52 parts in the scene\\[0.5mm]\begin{tabular}[t]{@{}c@{}}\img{figures/img/primcards/tile_base__wire_coil.jpg}{1.3cm}\\[-0.4mm]\parbox[t]{1.95cm}{\centering Wire coil ($\times$52)\\ \textit{Concertina wire}\\ 80\,$\times$\,80\,$\times$\,88.4\,cm}\end{tabular}}\end{minipage}
